title: Reports Surface on President Tinubu's Health Amid Governance Concerns
detail: Reports have been circulating about concerns over President Bola Tinubu's health, raising questions about his capacity to govern amid ongoing economic and security crises. The reports come as Nigeria faces continued pressure on multiple fronts, including persistent inflation, insecurity in the north, and demands for improved governance. Tinubu had previously returned to Nigeria on September 29 after an extended four-week stay in London and Paris, stating he was healthy and ready to resume work.
